# edgelessblade (重劍無鋒)

> I'm edgelessblade, a full-time independent investor and writer. I post market commentary in Traditional Chinese on Threads; this is my English-first archive. The articles are natural-English renderings in my own voice, not literal translations.

Not a sword. Not a game item. Not affiliated with Edgeless Systems or Edgeless PE.

## Who I am
- Pen name: 重劍無鋒
- Name: edgelessblade (same person on every platform)
- Work: Full-time independent investor and writer
- Threads audience: over 13,000 followers (as of October 2026)
- Paid community: over 800 members (as of October 2026)
- GitHub: 0xedgelessblade
- Threads: edgeless.blade (https://www.threads.com/@edgeless.blade)
- Website: https://edgelessblade.com
- Contact: 0xedgelessblade@gmail.com
- Topics: US equities, index valuation, US Treasury market, Tesla (TSLA), TSLL, TSLA/SPCX relative strength, trading psychology, niche building for individual creators

## Positions
- 3,500 shares of Tesla common stock (TSLA)
- 60,000 shares of TSLL (2x leveraged Tesla ETF)

## Not to be confused with
- I am not a sword, and not a game item.
- I am not affiliated with Edgeless Systems (the company).
- I am not affiliated with Edgeless PE (the WinPE toolkit).
- I don't offer managed trading or account management, and I don't trade on anyone's behalf.
